name: Wings That Don't Reach
source:
Oersted is a knight. After defeating his best friend in a tournament, he is given the hand of Princess Alicia in marriage. However, the demon king kidnaps her and Oersted is forced to rescue her, meeting people who will aid him in his quest.
This is a story of the Hero, Oersted.
And of the Demon King, Odio.

A retelling of Oersted's chapter from Live A Live (SNES), but in Visual Novel format.

[From [url=http://neotable.blogspot.com/p/wings-that-dont-reach.html]game's homepage[/url]]
translation:
奥斯特德是一名骑士。在比武大会上击败挚友后，他获准迎娶艾丽西亚公主。然而，魔王掳走了公主，奥斯特德不得不踏上营救之旅，并结识帮助他完成使命的人。
这是勇者奥斯特德的故事。
也是魔王奥迪奥的故事。

以视觉小说形式重新讲述超级任天堂游戏《时空勇士》中奥斯特德的章节。

[摘自[url=http://neotable.blogspot.com/p/wings-that-dont-reach.html]游戏主页[/url]]
